name: n019_l9scratch
purpose: Train a layer-9 Unit HiFi-GAN independently from scratch, matching the paper statement that the two vocoders are trained independently. The existing layer-9 branch was initialized from the layer-6 model and is therefore only an adaptation, not the paper-aligned training path.
decision_gate: After training, run the fixed 40-speaker dev selector over 20k-198k snapshots. Only proceed to full test/LS360 evaluation if UTMOS and WhiSQA recover toward the formal layer-6 model while WER regression is <= 0.25 pp; W-NT L must also remain near paper level.
dependency_plan: The AI path failed before training on cross-account record paths. HPC Job 1148888 launched correctly but was cancelled after 24 seconds to prioritize the decisive residual0.25 S run. Do not resubmit 1148888; resume scratch training later in a new Job after S result.
